problem_text: Consider all polynomials P(x) with real coefficients that have the following property: for any two real numbers x and y one has |y^2 - P(x)| <= 2|x| if and only if |x^2 - P(y)| <= 2|y|. Determine all possible values of P(0).
solution_text:
Step 1: Substitute x=0. Then |y^2 - P(0)| <= 0, so y^2 = P(0). The right side becomes |P(y)| <= 2|y|. So the condition becomes: y^2 = P(0) iff |P(y)| <= 2|y|.
Step 2: Case P(0) < 0. y^2 = P(0) has no real solution, so the left side is always false. Therefore |P(y)| > 2|y| for all y. Since P(0) < 0 and P is continuous, P(y) < -2|y| for all y. Then |y^2 - P(x)| = y^2 + |P(x)| > 2|x| (always false) and |x^2 - P(y)| = x^2 + |P(y)| > 2|y| (always false). So false iff false = true, the condition holds. Example: P(x) = -x^2 - 3.
Step 3: Case P(0) >= 0. y = ±sqrt(P(0)) are solutions, so |P(±sqrt(P(0)))| <= 2*sqrt(P(0)).
Step 4: Substitute y=0: |P(x)| <= 2|x| iff x^2 = P(0). Combined with Step 1: |P(t)| <= 2|t| only at t = ±sqrt(P(0)).
Step 5: P(0) = 0 leads to contradiction (need |P(0)| > 0 but P(0) = 0).
Step 6: P(0) > 0. Try P(x) = x^2 + a. P(sqrt(a)) = 2a, need 2a <= 2*sqrt(a) so a <= 1. Using y = sqrt(a) in the equivalence: left side gives |a - x^2 - a| = x^2 <= 2|x| (i.e., |x| <= 2), right side gives |x^2 - 2a| <= 2*sqrt(a). For equivalence: 2a - 2*sqrt(a) = 0 and 2a + 2*sqrt(a) = 4, giving a = 1.
Step 7: Verify P(x) = x^2 + 1. |y^2 - x^2 - 1| <= 2|x| iff (|x|-1)^2 <= y^2 <= (|x|+1)^2 iff ||x| - |y|| <= 1. By symmetry the right side gives the same condition. Both sides identical, so equivalence holds.
Answer: P(0) in (-infinity, 0) union {1}.
solution_summary: 代入x=0得y²=P(0)⟺|P(y)|≤2|y|。P(0)<0时两边恒假使等价vacuously成立；P(0)≥0时结合y=0代入和多项式结构分析，P(0)=0矛盾，P(0)>0仅P(0)=1可行(P(x)=x²+1使两边化为||x|-|y||≤1)。
structure_features: 实系数多项式P(x)满足对称条件|y²-P(x)|≤2|x|⟺|x²-P(y)|≤2|y|，要求P(0)的所有可能值。条件具有x↔y交换对称性，涉及绝对值不等式和等价关系。
key_insight: 代入x=0将条件化为y²=P(0)⟺|P(y)|≤2|y|，当P(0)<0时两边恒假使等价vacuously成立——这是最反直觉的关键转折

rounds.question: 描述这道题的结构：已知什么条件，要求什么，条件中有什么对称性？
rounds.expected_answer: 已知多项式P(x)实系数，满足对任意x,y有|y²-P(x)|≤2|x|⟺|x²-P(y)|≤2|y|。要求P(0)的所有可能值。条件在x↔y交换下对称。关键是对if and only if的理解——两个不等式必须同时成立或同时不成立。

rounds.question: 列出所有可能的分析方向：你能想到哪些代入特殊值或变形的方式？
rounds.expected_answer: ①代入x=0 ②代入y=0 ③代入x=y ④代入x=-y ⑤尝试P(x)=x²+c ⑥尝试P(x)=-x²+c ⑦分析条件的几何意义 ⑧利用x↔y对称性

rounds.question: 试一下最自然的猜测P(x)=x²，即P(0)=0，看看条件是否满足
rounds.expected_answer: P(x)=x²时，|y²-x²|≤2|x|⟺|x²-y²|≤2|y|。取x=1,y=0：|1|≤2成立但|1|≤0不成立。所以P(x)=x²不满足条件，P(0)=0可能不在答案中。

rounds.question: 代入x=0，仔细分析左边的绝对值不等式|y²-P(0)|≤0意味着什么，然后写出完整的等价条件
rounds.expected_answer: x=0时左边|y²-P(0)|≤0，绝对值非负故只能等于0，即y²=P(0)。右边变为|P(y)|≤2|y|。所以条件变为：y²=P(0)⟺|P(y)|≤2|y|。

rounds.question: 根据y²=P(0)是否有实解，分两种情况分析。特别关注P(0)<0时会发生什么
rounds.expected_answer: P(0)<0：y²=P(0)无实解，左边恒假，故|P(y)|>2|y|对所有y。因P(0)<0且连续，P(y)<-2|y|。此时原条件两边都恒假，false⟺false=true，条件满足！

rounds.question: 对P(0)≥0的情况，再代入y=0，结合x=0的结果，分析P(0)的正值中哪些可行。尝试P(x)=x²+a
rounds.expected_answer: y=0时：|P(x)|≤2|x|⟺x²=P(0)。若P(x)=x²+a(a>0)：P(√a)=2a需≤2√a即a≤1。用y=√a验证等价性，得2a-2√a=0且2a+2√a=4，解得a=1。P(0)=0矛盾。

rounds.question: 验证P(x)=x²+1确实满足条件，然后写出完整答案
